blocks.title: Na deze pdf kun je
bullets: toestandswerkwoorden herkennen die in een andere betekenis wél -ing krijgen
beleefd en voorzichtig formuleren met het verleden (I was wondering)
subtiele verschillen tussen simple en continuous gebruiken

head: Werkwoord
Toestand (simple)
Handeling (continuous)
rows: I'm seeing the doctor at four. (afspraak)
She's appearing in a new film. (optreden)

blocks.title: He's being silly
blocks.text: be in de continuous beschrijft tijdelijk gedrag, niet karakter: You're being very quiet today = je bent vandaag erg stil (anders dan normaal). Het Nederlands heeft daar geen aparte vorm voor.

Met always, constantly, forever + continuous klaag je over iets dat vaak gebeurt: He's always leaving his socks on the floor! You're constantly interrupting me. Dezelfde zin in de simple is neutraal: He always leaves at eight.
3. Het verleden voor afstand en beleefdheid

head: Engels
Effect
rows: I was wondering if you could help me.
I wanted to ask you something.
zachter dan I want to ask
beleefd aanbod in een winkel of café
I was hoping we could talk.

blocks.title: Ik wilde even vragen ...
blocks.text: Het Nederlands kent dit ook: Ik wilde even vragen of ... Het Engels gaat nog verder met de continuous: I was just wondering whether ... is de meest beleefde manier om iets te vragen.

head: Simple
Continuous
rows: I'm living in Bristol for now. (tijdelijk)
I've been reading your report. (bezig, misschien niet af)
What did you do last night? (de handeling)
What were you doing at nine? (bezig op een moment)
We'll be seeing you soon. (vanzelfsprekend, informeel)
She is having a lot of money.
She has a lot of money.
I wonder if you can help me.
I was wondering if you could help me.

blocks.text: Vul de simple of de continuous in. De antwoorden staan op de laatste pagina.

items.full: I am thinking about changing my job.
I think you're making a mistake.
We were having dinner when you called.

items.q: You ______ very quiet today. Is anything wrong?
items.full: You are being very quiet today. Is anything wrong?

items.q: I was ______ if you could give me some advice.
items.full: I was wondering if you could give me some advice.

items.q: I ______ the dentist tomorrow at ten.
items.full: I am seeing the dentist tomorrow at ten.

items.q: She ______ in a flat until her house is ready.
items.full: She is living in a flat until her house is ready.

items.q: Ik denk erover om te verhuizen.
Hij laat altijd zijn sokken liggen!
items.a: He's always leaving his socks on the floor!

items.q: Ik vroeg me af of u me kon helpen.
items.a: I was wondering if you could help me.
